'''Kevin Esteve Rigail''' (born 27 December 1989) is an [[alpine skier]] and [[professional golfer]] from [[Andorra]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kevin Esteve Rigail |url=http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/kevin-esteve-rigail_ath1015025Be.html |work=Vancouver 2010 |accessdate=15 December 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100409031844/http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/kevin-esteve-rigail_ath1015025Be.html |archivedate=9 April 2010}}</ref> He competed for [[Andorra at the 2010 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference}}</ref>

==Golf career==
Esteve turned professional in 2015 after breaking his knee in 2014.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kevin Esteve - From slippery slopes to six-footers |url=https://menatour.golf/news/details/kevin-esteve-from-slippery-slopes-to-six-footers |publisher=MENA Tour |access-date=20 February 2023 |date=19 May 2022}}</ref> He has primarily played on the [[Alps Tour]], [[MENA Tour]] and [[Nordic Golf League]].
